title: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Ice blends the sweet taste of ripe Strawberries with a crisp Ice layer. The fruit provides a juicy, summery character, while the cool finish keeps the flavour fresh and balanced. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt delivers smooth flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Strawberry Ice is ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, pens and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Strawberry Ice is a satisfying fruit-and-ice option for those who enjoy classic flavours with a refreshing twist.
